svg.title: Initialization comparison with matched adaptation settings
svg.desc: Clean contexts; same AdamW preset across identity, random and pretrained starts. Three random/pretrained seeds are separate traces. Fourier LS fits exactly the same low-mode-plus-local model class; its dedicated quantitative panel keeps the near-roundoff baseline visible.
